purpose: Validate candidate-vector generation -> dynamic Actions matrix -> KO aggregation -> optimizer state update -> next-generation proposal. Results must not be used as H9 promotion/refinement evidence.
algorithm_note: A dependency-free diagonal evolution-strategy controller is used to validate orchestration. It is deliberately pluggable; CMA-ES or another optimizer may replace the ask/tell policy later without changing the match-worker contract.
isolation: Seeds 71000+ are reserved for this controller plumbing dry-run and are separate from H9 preregistered research seeds.
The 50k budget is chosen to keep the dry-run cheap; it is not the 200k research-strength regime.
No dry-run win/loss result may select, promote, reject, or rank H9 research values.
Only controller correctness, artifact flow, deterministic candidate generation, and next-generation state transitions are in scope.
